# Build-time math renderer

`katex.cjs` is the unmodified KaTeX 0.16.47 CommonJS distribution from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.47/dist/katex.js (KaTeX upstream release).
MIT license is retained in KATEX-LICENSE. This matches the interactive book’s pinned
browser renderer. Only generated HTML and MathML are published; this directory is
outside the public allowlist. The build needs no network or npm installation.

Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/releases/tag/v0.16.47
